name: security-review
title: Security review: where an order request can go wrong

steps.note: Public entry. A JWT is required and the customer id comes from the token.
The auth check, and the AUTH_DISABLED bypass that makes every caller admin.
Any authenticated user can read any order, and errors are not handled.
Internal route with no authentication of its own.
String-built SQL: the injection sink reached from the previous step.
Admin-only route that fetches a caller-chosen URL (SSRF).
Subprocess call with an argv list, so no shell injection; quantity is unbounded upstream.
Event over plain AMQP with a default credential in the URL.
Consumer trusts any message on the queue and requeues failures without a limit.
Shared table written by two services.
